items.text: Women in India choose, grow and restart careers in every field, and good advice focuses on evidence about the work, support systems, safety and rights rather than assumptions about which jobs suit women.
Plan for support, safety and rights, and build proof so breaks and moves do not erase your record.
Leave, maternity benefits, workplace harassment protections and scheme details are set by law and employer policy and change.
